# task\-ranking\-offset\-aware — Make task ranking offset\-aware like byCreatedAtThenId
status: todo  priority: 3  scope: scope-core
readiness: not_eligible  reason: status_todo

From the 2026\-08\-15 complete code audit: \`byPriorityThenCreatedAtThenId\` \(src/core/tasks\.ts:64\-73\) compares \`created\_at\` as plain strings, while \`byCreatedAtThenId\` \(src/core/time\.ts:56\-64\) is offset\-aware via \`Date\.parse\`\. On a shared ledger authored across machines with different timezone offsets \(e\.g\. \+02:00 vs \+03:00\), lexical comparison mis\-orders records whose instants differ only by the offset\. Align the ADR\-0008 comparator with the offset\-aware parsing used elsewhere, keeping the missing\-\`created\_at\`\-sorts\-earliest and \`id\` tiebreak semantics\.
